operation: One-time cash contribution intent (ACH debit via sponsor processor)
idempotency: Client key on intent; effect key to processor; processor observations via inbox (UNB-XIN-EVA-005)
authorization_timing: Intake: submit right for fund; execution: authority, holds, exposure limits, mandatory acknowledgments
failure_behavior: Processor timeout -> OutcomeUnknown; return -> reversal per CNV-FIN-003
recovery_behavior: Reconcile against processor payout/three-way match (UNB-XIN-BNK-008); never auto-retry debit
audit: Intent, authorization record, four contribution dates, reversals
user_status: Received -> Pending funds -> Completed gift (date per instrument rule) / Returned
acceptance: Given processor timeout after submit, When status unknown, Then no second debit is initiated and the contribution shows 'confirming with bank'

idempotency: GiftIntent key; custodian receipt observation keyed by custodian reference
failure_behavior: Unmatched receipt -> exception case; partial delivery tracked
recovery_behavior: Matching case (UNB-RCN-WF-001); intent lapse per policy
audit: Gift intent, custody receipt evidence, completed-gift date = date received in sponsor custody
user_status: Expected -> Received in custody -> Completed gift (date shown)
acceptance: Given a receipt arrives Jan 2 for a Dec 30 intent, When matched, Then gift date is Jan 2 and receipt for the intent never shows Dec 30 as tax date

authorization_timing: Each occurrence re-checks authorization and holds
acceptance: Given a restore from backup, When the scheduler resumes, Then each due occurrence fires exactly once

idempotency: Client key; reservation atomic with decision
authorization_timing: Intake: advisor right on fund; execution: authority, eligibility (approved freshness window), sanctions, holds, capacity, acknowledgments
failure_behavior: Business decline is a Completed outcome with reason
recovery_behavior: Re-execution on version conflict; expired if not started by deadline
audit: Recommendation, decision record, reservation, policy versions
user_status: Received -> Under review / Approved -> Payment scheduled -> Paid (settled)
acceptance: Given two recommendations exceeding available balance submitted concurrently, When processed, Then exactly one reserves capacity and the other is declined for insufficient funds

authorization_timing: Each occurrence re-checks authority, eligibility and capacity
failure_behavior: Eligibility change -> occurrence declined with donor notice
acceptance: Given charity eligibility lapses before an occurrence, When it fires, Then it is declined and the donor is notified; no payment instruction is created

idempotency: Client key at scheduling; occurrence key at due date
authorization_timing: Re-confirmation of authority and eligibility at due date (TVR-GR-008)
failure_behavior: Due-date checks fail -> declined with notice
recovery_behavior: Expiry if not executed within window
audit: Award, recognition, payment, settlement dates distinct
acceptance: Given a grant scheduled for Dec 31 that runs Jan 2 after an outage, When it executes, Then the award date records actual execution and the UI never stated Dec 31 as paid

authorization_timing: Segregation of duties at decision time
acceptance: Given the preparer attempts to approve, When submitted, Then refused for segregation of duties

operation: Grant payment instruction release / relay to sponsor rail
idempotency: Effect key = idempotency chain; rail idempotency where supported
authorization_timing: Atomic check of hold version and authority at dispatch (fencing token)
recovery_behavior: Unknown protocol (CNV-PAY-004); fallback rail only with confirmed non-execution
user_status: Payment scheduled -> Sent to bank -> Settled / Returned / Confirming
acceptance: Given the hold registry version changed after approval, When dispatch runs, Then dispatch fails closed and no instruction is released

operation: Payment outcome observation (bank file, webhook, trace)
idempotency: Inbox key = provider message id or file+record hash
recovery_behavior: Continuous reconciliation; breaks block statements only for affected funds
acceptance: Given the same bank return file is imported twice, When processed, Then one return is recorded

failure_behavior: Unobtainable after 30 days -> dual approval with duplicate-risk acceptance
recovery_behavior: No automatic retry; reissue only after confirmed stop/void
user_status: Confirming with bank -> Settled / Not sent / Reissued
acceptance: Given an operator retries without qualifying proof, When submitted, Then no second instruction is sent

operation: Charity eligibility data refresh (IRS Pub 78, EO BMF, auto-revocation)
cache_eligibility: Imported release: yes (immutable versioned); eligibility decision: no
failure_behavior: Stale or failed import -> release-time checks fail safe when outside freshness window
user_status: Registry 'data as of' date shown to staff
acceptance: Given an import fails, When a grant release is attempted beyond the freshness window, Then release fails safe
Given a review expires, When a grant is released, Then eligibility uses the latest valid evidence or fails safe

idempotency: Instruction key; custodian idempotency where supported
authorization_timing: Execution re-check of trading freeze, authority
user_status: Requested -> Sent to custodian -> Executed / Rejected
acceptance: Given a trading freeze is active, When the instruction executes, Then it is held and the donor sees 'paused by sponsor policy'

authorization_timing: Deterministic policy or human approval out of tolerance
recovery_behavior: Republication creates new version, never overwrite
acceptance: Given NAV publication runs twice for one date, When executed, Then one published version exists

authorization_timing: Authority and verified successor at execution
acceptance: Given a bulk transfer worker crashes mid-batch, When resumed, Then completed items are not repeated

failure_behavior: Unbalanced entry -> poison/quarantine for that book
acceptance: Given the same event is delivered twice, When posted, Then one journal entry exists

failure_behavior: Fund item failure -> quarantined item only
acceptance: Given a fee run restarts, When rerun, Then no fund is charged twice for the period

operation: Manual processing fee (service charge, e.g. stop/reissue)
acceptance: Given a charge type absent from the disclosed schedule, When entered, Then refused
Given a donor responds during the notice window, When the timer fires, Then no distribution occurs

failure_behavior: Break -> human queue; blocks statements for affected funds only
acceptance: Given an unexplained cash break, When statements generate, Then only affected funds are blocked
Given a reconciliation break on fund A, When the run completes, Then fund B statements are issued and fund A shows 'delayed'

operation: Annual DAF data package / complex report
authorization_timing: Report authority at request and delivery
acceptance: Given the worker restarts during generation, When resumed, Then completed sections are not regenerated

idempotency: Notification id as provider idempotency key where supported
failure_behavior: Provider failure -> retry (email is not a financial effect); mandatory-legal notices retried on another channel
recovery_behavior: At-least-once; duplicates tolerated only for non-legal informational email
acceptance: Given consent is withdrawn after queuing, When sending, Then message is not sent
Given a delegation expired, When the administrator acts, Then refused

failure_behavior: DB unavailable -> sponsor bank channel remains (CNV-PLT-007)
recovery_behavior: Hold versions replayed after restore before dispatch resumes
acceptance: Given the worker role is stopped, When a hold is placed, Then subsequent dispatch is refused
Given a revocation, When the revoked principal's queued command executes, Then it is rejected as not authorized

audit: Change and notice to previous channel
acceptance: Given a contact channel change, When a high-value recommendation follows within the hold window, Then it is held for confirmation

authorization_timing: HostContext binding at intake; full re-check at execution
failure_behavior: Network failure after submit -> status lookup by key (WG-12)
acceptance: Given the network drops after submit, When the widget retries, Then one recommendation exists

execution_model: DurableCommand prepared by agent; execution requires human authority above A2
idempotency: Agent must supply key; no blind replay (AIN-020)
authorization_timing: Recorded authority of principal; agent level checked at execution
acceptance: Given an agent submits an action reserved to a human, When executed, Then the API rejects it

authorization_timing: Publication authority and approval at publish
acceptance: See UNB-AVL-021

failure_behavior: DB down -> cannot acknowledge; gated ops also unavailable
acceptance: See UNB-AVL-023

consistency: Authoritative for available-to-grant; BoundedStaleness acceptable for valuation-based market value with as-of
cache_eligibility: Available-to-grant: never; market value display: eligible after criteria
failure_behavior: DB down -> unavailable; client may show last-known with as-of label (INT-012)
acceptance: Given a pending reservation, When viewing available-to-grant, Then the amount excludes the reservation

cache_eligibility: Eligible after criteria (public data, no PII)
acceptance: Given search index lags, When results display, Then the data date is shown and grant eligibility is rechecked at recommendation
Given any lifecycle state, When queried, Then an approved label and next expected event are returned
